d: The Mavericks defeated the Clippers, 110-100 tonight in Dallas. Kyrie Irving contributed a team-high 25 points to go with 6 rebounds 4 assists and 3 three pointers, with Cooper Flagg of the Mavericks adding an additional 22 points (6-16 FG, 3-6 3P) in the game. Brook Lopez finished with a team-high 21 points along with 6 rebounds for the Clippers in the losing effort. The Mavericks improve their record to 9-7 with the win, while the Clippers fall to 4-11 for the season.
